# CANDIDATE: ORB_VWAP_BREAK

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

An opening-range breakout that coincides with price on the correct side of VWAP and a bullish/bearish EMA ribbon adds institutional bias, increasing follow‑through probability. The confluence of OR break, VWAP position, and EMA ribbon alignment filters for higher-quality momentum shifts driven by institutional participation.

## Mechanism

Compute the opening range (OR) high/low from the first 30‑minute bar (09:30‑10:00 ET). On 5‑minute bars, go long when price closes above OR high, price > VWAP, and the 8/21/55 EMA ribbon is bullish (8 EMA > 21 EMA > 55 EMA). Go short when price closes below OR low, price < VWAP, and the ribbon is bearish (8 EMA < 21 EMA < 55 EMA). Exit shape: Initial stop at the opposite OR bound (low for long, high for short). Take profit at 1.5R or trail 12% of the high‑water mark using a chandelier trail. Regime hint: Works best in moderate volatility (VIX 12‑22) and on days without major news releases in the first 30 min; avoid choppy sessions where ATR < 0.3×20‑day ATR.
